title: Sales performance dashboard for a non-profit company
problem: Leadership got sales numbers from three teams that never agreed.
approach: agreed one definition for each metric with finance
modelled the data in SQL into a clean star schema
built a Power BI report with drill-down by region and rep
metrics: replaced 5 manual weekly reports
cut month-end reporting from 3 days to 2

title: Marketing channel attribution analysis for a manufacturing brand
problem: The team could not say which channels drove sales.
approach: joined ad platform exports with order data
compared last-click with a position-based model
presented budget shifts with expected impact ranges
metrics: found that 27% of spend went to channels with no measurable return
the reallocated budget lowered cost per order by 13%

title: Customer cohort and retention analysis for a media app
problem: Growth looked healthy but revenue was flat.
approach: built monthly cohorts from event data
measured retention and revenue per cohort
identified the onboarding step where most users dropped
metrics: found a 50% drop-off at one onboarding step
the fix raised 30-day retention by 3 points

title: Excel reporting automation for a manufacturing finance team
problem: A weekly report took a full day of copy-paste across workbooks.
approach: rebuilt the report with Power Query and a clean data model
replaced manual lookups with structured references
documented the refresh steps for the team
metrics: cut the weekly report from 9 hours to 2
removed 7 recurring manual errors found in the old process

title: Analytics warehouse with dbt for a media startup
problem: Every analysis started with an hour of cleaning raw tables.
approach: set up staging, intermediate and mart models in dbt
added tests for keys, nulls and accepted values
documented each model so non-analysts could use the marts
metrics: built 38 tested models
cut time to answer ad-hoc questions by about 49%

title: A/B test design and analysis for a non-profit product team
problem: Tests were stopped early and results were read from dashboards.
approach: set sample sizes from expected effect and baseline rates
analysed results with confidence intervals and guardrail metrics
wrote a short guide so the team could run tests the same way
metrics: reviewed 12 past tests and found half were underpowered
the shipped variant raised conversion by 3%

title: Operations KPI dashboard in Tableau for a real estate company
problem: Managers could not see delays until customers complained.
approach: connected Tableau to the operations database
built KPI views for delay, throughput and backlog
set threshold alerts for each site
metrics: cut average delay by 21% after the first quarter
rolled the dashboard out to 5 sites

title: Customer survey analysis for a edtech organisation
problem: Thousands of survey responses sat unread every quarter.
approach: cleaned and weighted the responses
coded open-text answers into themes
reported drivers of satisfaction with clear charts
metrics: analysed 8680 responses
identified 5 drivers that explained most dissatisfaction

title: Self-serve reporting in Looker Studio for a hospitality agency
